name: EAGLE-4 speculative decoding triples Qwen 3.8 27B speed on one RTX 5090
title: EAGLE-4 speculative decoding triples Qwen 3.8 27B speed on one RTX 5090
summary: A builder ran EAGLE-4 tree speculative decoding with a 4-bit Qwen 3.8 27B on a single RTX 5090 and measured one request going from 57.6 to 175.9 tokens per second, a first-hand check that the new drafter pays off on a consumer card.
